# http/enrich

A built-in enrich adapter for person records: it needs the step's `uses:` fields and declares no fields of its own. It publishes no per-record estimate, so plan prints `?`, and it demands no credential.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `http/enrich` |
| version | 1 |
| role | enrich |
| entity type | person |
| credentials | none |
| cost estimate per record | not published |

## Needs

The fields the step's `uses:` line names, and nothing else.

## Provides

None declared. What it writes depends on its `with:` config, and plan reports the fields as the step resolves them.

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth` | object |  |  |
| `auth.env` | string | yes |  |
| `auth.name` | string |  |  |
| `auth.prefix` | string |  |  |
| `auth.type` | one of header, query, bearer | yes |  |
| `entity_type` | string |  |  |
| `extract` | object |  | Inline JSON mode: field → dotted response path |
| `field` | string |  | The declared content field (markdown mode) — canonical or namespaced |
| `freshness_days` | integer | yes | REQUIRED, no default: web content rots. Doubles as the step's cache window. |
| `headers` | object |  |  |
| `keep_payloads` | boolean |  | per-step override of payload retention |
| `markdown` | boolean |  | Fetch a page and store it as markdown under field: |
| `max_bytes` | integer |  | Response size cap (default 262144). An oversized response stores no field — the record advances counted empty, never truncated silently — and is still retained as a payload for the retention window. |
| `method` | one of GET, POST |  | Default GET |
| `query` | object |  |  |
| `url` | string | yes | Request URL, templated from {{record.\<field\>}} placeholders — which are also the step's derived needs |

## Example

A minimal step:

```yaml
  - id: enrich
    use: http/enrich
```
